messages:
nora: Drafting a short enterprise one-pager that we can hand to field during renewals. Needs: quick metric callouts (latency/SLO), security checklist, deployment options, and a short funnel routing snippet for inbound renewals or upgrade interest.

liam: For renewals the CTA should be 'Upgrade to Dedicated' with a line about predictable cost per-token and reserved capacity. Add an example ROI stat: 'migration to dedicated reduced tail latency incidents by 60% for X customer'. Keep it generic.

frank: Security checklist: encryption-in-transit, encryption-at-rest, BYOK, HSM available, audit logs, SOC2/ISO references, optional on-prem package. Also mention KMS rotation schedule and default audit retention 90 days (extendable).

julia: SLO copy: We can say 'SLA-backed uptime, configurable latency SLOs per route, and optional financial credits on objective misses.' We must avoid legal specifics here.

marco: Routing snippet for renewal flow:
```
if lead.lifecycle_stage == "renewal" and lead.contract_size > 50000:
  assign.team = "account-exec"
  nudge.template = "renewal-dedicated-upgrade"
  add.tags = ["renewal","upgrade-opportunity"]
```

nora: Also need a concise benchmark blurb for the one-pager: 'Example ded. capacity: p95 latency 80-120ms for mixed-gen workloads; batching & KV cache commonly reduce per-token spend 30-50% depending on prompt reuse.'

liam: Include a short note on deployment modes: Hosted for quick trials, Dedicated for committed capacity, Private for regulated or air-gapped. One-liner benefits for each.

frank: I'll provide the legal-safe phrasing for 'financial credits' and pass to legal for approval.

upload-bot: draft created: https://drive.company/redwood/marketing/renewal-onepager-draft (perm: marketing-view)

nora: Great. Julia, can you and Frank finalize the SLO and legal phrasing by EOD tomorrow? We'll hand to AE enablement after that. Thanks.
